scenes.text: Ama has 20 books and receives 8 more. How many now? Let us think carefully. Add 20 and 8. The answer is 28. Great work!
Kofi has 31 pencils and gives away 9. How many remain? Let us think carefully. Subtract 9 from 31. The answer is 22. Great work!
Abena has 24 oranges. She gets 10, then gives away 3. How many remain? Let us think carefully. First add 10; next subtract 3. The answer is 31. Great work!
Ama has 26 beads and receives 11 more. How many now? Let us think carefully. Add 26 and 11. The answer is 37. Great work!
